title: Offset-form evidence probe
question: Can an annotator cite evidence by character offsets as reliably as by quote (D2 §7.3's premise)?
method: Fresh subagent cites T1–T4 by offsets.

agents.separation: fresh subagent; read only its input folder and output folder (transcript audit of every file opened, 2026-10-28); wrote only its output folder; counted offsets with str.find

conclusion: The annotator computed offsets with tool scripts, so the probe shows tool-assisted conversion works, not that a model without tools counts offsets; moved to S3.
